title: Generator Maintenance Inspection Checklist
subtitle: Standby Generator Maintenance: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Generator Maintenance Inspection Checklist covers engine-generator, transfer equipment, fuel system, starting system, and load served. The facility emergency-power coordinator records Standby Generator Maintenance criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Generator Maintenance Inspection Checklist keeps Standby Generator Maintenance exceptions visible until the facility emergency-power coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Generator Maintenance Inspection Checklist at generator enclosure, fuel area, transfer switch, and served distribution. Document engine-generator, transfer equipment, fuel system, starting system, and load served identity before Standby Generator Maintenance begins. Compare engine-generator, transfer equipment, fuel system, starting system, and load served findings with stated Standby Generator Maintenance criteria; route unresolved Standby Generator Maintenance issues to qualified generator service supervisor. For Generator Maintenance Inspection Checklist, confirm requirements for Standby Generator Maintenance. Ask qualified generator service supervisor to review Standby Generator Maintenance conditions beyond the facility emergency-power coordinator's role.

sections.title: Checklist context and subject record
sections.guidance: For Standby Generator Maintenance, identify responsible parties, generator enclosure, fuel area, transfer switch, and served distribution, and the linked engine-generator, transfer equipment, fuel system, starting system, and load served source.

fields.label: Make, model, serial, rating, and fuel type
Maintenance interval, hour meter, and last-load-test reference

sections.title: Checklist points, conditions, and actions
sections.guidance: Capture Standby Generator Maintenance facts for engine-generator, transfer equipment, fuel system, starting system, and load served; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Standby Generator Maintenance inspection checks
items: Fluid levels, leaks, hoses, belts, and exhaust condition
Battery, charger, terminals, and starting result
Fuel supply, containment, and visible piping condition
Cooling, ventilation, louvers, and enclosure condition
No-load or authorized load operating readings
Transfer, alarms, shutdowns, and return-to-normal result

sections.title: Inspection disposition and reviewer acknowledgment
sections.guidance: Before closing Standby Generator Maintenance, identify what failed or was not inspected, who owns correction, and when examination resumes. Facility Emergency-Power Coordinator preserves the decision.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Abnormal temperature, pressure, vibration, or noise
Failed start, transfer, alarm, or shutdown
Load test requested without safe approved conditions
Oil, coolant, voltage, frequency, and pressure readings
blocks.guidance: Pause Standby Generator Maintenance when fuel, exhaust, electrical, starting, transfer, or shutdown concern prevents safe standby readiness. Retain the available Standby Generator Maintenance proof and route unresolved engine-generator, transfer equipment, fuel system, starting system, and load served scope to facility emergency-power coordinator.
